subject: english
question:
**Choose the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

 

The mason is building the house in the corner.

options.text: The house in the corner is being build by the mason.
The house in the corner are being build by the mason.
The house in the corner is being built by the mason.
The house in the corner is being build to the mason.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The house in the corner is being built by the mason.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the active voice, where the subject "**the mason**" is performing the action of "**building.**"
 
• To convert this into the passive voice, the object "**the house in the corne**r" becomes the subject, and the verb "**is building**" changes to "**is being built.**"
 
• The original subject "**the mason**" now comes after "**by**."
 
• Therefore, the correct passive form of the given sentence is: '**The house in the corner is being built by the mason.**'

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer
